an4.186:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.186:1.2: Kena nu kho bhante loko niyyati, kena loko parikissati, kassa ca uppannassa vasaṃ gacchati?
an4.186:2.2: Bhaddako kho te bhikkhu ummaggo bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ kalyāṇī paripucchā,
an4.186:2.4: kena nu kho bhante loko niyyati, kena loko parikissati, kassa ca uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatīti?
an4.186:2.6: Cittena kho bhikkhu loko niyyati cittena parikissati cittassa uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatīti. 2.
an4.186:3.1: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
an4.186:3.2: bahussuto dhammadharo bahussuto dhammadharo ti bhante vuccati,
an4.186:3.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bahussuto dhammadharo hotīti?
an4.186:4.2: Bhaddako kho te bhikkhu uṃmaggo bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ kalyāṇī paripucchā,
an4.186:4.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bahussuto dhammadharo hotīti.
an4.186:4.7: Bahu kho bhikkhu mayā dhammā desitā--suttaṃ
an4.186:4.8: geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.186:4.9: Catuppādāya ce pi bhikkhu gāthāya atthaṃ aññāya dhammaṃ aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti bahussuto dhammadharo ti alaṃ vacanāyāti. 3.
an4.186:5.1: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ . . . uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
an4.186:5.2: sutavā nibbedhikapañño sutavā nibbedhikapañño ti bhante vuccati,
an4.186:5.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotīti?
an4.186:6.2: Bhaddako kho te bhikkhu ummaggo . . . kalyānī paripucchā,
an4.186:6.4: sutavā nibbedhikapañño sutavā nibbedhikapañño ti bhante vuccati,
an4.186:6.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotīti?
an4.186:6.7: Idha bhikkhu bhikkhuno idaṃ dukkhan ti sutaṃ hoti paññāya c' assa atthaṃ ativijjha passati,
an4.186:6.8: ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti sutaṃ hoti paññāya c' assa atthaṃ ativijjha passati,
an4.186:6.11: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotīti. 4.
an4.186:7.1: Sādhu bhante ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ . . . uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
an4.186:7.2: paṇḍito mahāpañño paṇḍito mahāpañño ti bhante vuccati,
an4.186:7.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante paṇḍito mahāpañño hotīti?
an4.186:8.2: Bhaddako kho te bhikkhu ummaggo bhaddakaṃ . . . kalyānī paripucchā,
an4.186:8.4: paṇḍito mahāpañño paṇḍito mahāpañño ti bhante vuccati,
an4.186:8.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante paṇḍito mahāpañño hotīti?
an4.186:8.7: Idha bhikkhu paṇḍito mahāpañño n' ev' attavyābādhāya ceteti na paravyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayavyābādhāya ceteti, attahitaṃ parahitaṃ ubhayahitaṃ sabbalokahitam eva cintamāno cinteti.
an4.186:8.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu paṇḍito mahāpañño hotīti. 187. 1.
